text:
nina_marketing: Hey runtime team — we need a compact artifact bundle for the launch writeup and webinar slides. Goal: defensible latency + cost claims with reproducible artifacts. Can you produce the following?
- latency CDFs (csv) for cold, warmed-short, warmed-long at seq 32 / 128 / 512
- per-1k-token cost estimates comparing v1-fp16 vs v1-q4; include breakdown (compute, infra, amortized model load)
- embed endpoint metrics: p50, p95, p99 for 512-dim vectors (both quant and fp)
- small sample set: 20 actual user-like prompts + raw outputs (PII redacted) for webinar QA
- a 3-paragraph methodology blurb we can paste into blog + exact run command and docker image sha

jules_runtime: We can run this on Dedicated to keep variance low. Quick choices to confirm:
1) "warmed-short" = 256 warmup tokens, "warmed-long" = 1024 warmup tokens?
2) Weighted aggregation: use launch_cohort.json weights or produce both cohort-weighted and uniform synthetic?
3) Which seed and which input shard should we publish for reproducibility?

tara_ops: For costs use our standard spot pricing model and include a reserved-capacity scenario. Also make sure artifacts go to s3://redwood-launch-artifacts/{run_ts}/ and set ACL to org-read.

nina_marketing: Yes to both warmed definitions above. Produce both aggregation types (cohort-weighted + uniform). Use seed=2024 and include input_shard_07. We'll link cohort file from marketing drive. Include a tiny CSV mapping prompts->intent buckets for the 20 sample prompts.

jules_runtime: Working plan:
- outputs: latency_cdf__{model}__seq{n}__warm{type}.csv (cdf: bin, pct, lat_ms)
- cost files: cost_breakdown__{model}.csv (line items: compute_usd, infra_usd, amortized_load_usd, total_usd_per_1k)
- embeds: embed_latencies__512__{model}.csv (p50/p95/p99 rows)
- sample bundle: sample_prompts_and_outputs_20.zip (pre and post PII counts)
- methodology.txt with a short paragraph + exact `run_perf.sh` invocation and docker sha
ETA: first artifacts in ~18 hours, then nightly reruns for 48h window.

ed_ci: CI job scheduled: perf-launch-validate @ 2024-07-12T04:00Z x3. Will post job run ids when kicked off.

jules_runtime: Minimal run command we will attach (feel free to paste):
```
DOCKER_SHA=sha256:fa12be...
./run_perf.sh \
  --model gpt-small@v1 \
  --variant q4 (or fp16) \
  --seq 128 \
  --workers 12 \
  --warmup 1024 \
  --seed 2024 \
  --input-shard input_shard_07.jsonl \
  --out s3://redwood-launch-artifacts/${RUN_TS}/ \
  --ci-tag perf-launch-validate
```

scrubbot: PII-scrub job: tools/pii_scrub.py --redact --report-counts pre_post will be applied. Report will include #redactions per file.

nina_marketing: Nice. One more: can you include the small CSV we can drop into the blog that shows 3 representative prompt->latency rows (seq 32/128/512) and corresponding cost per 1k tokens so editors can eyeball numbers?

jules_runtime: Yep, we'll add preview_rows_{model}.csv with representative samples. We'll also include a tiny README with instructions to reproduce the exact run (docker sha, commit, flags, seed, and path to input shard).

tara_ops: Reminder: please tag infra-ops on the first upload so we can confirm storage lifecycle policy and retention.

nina_marketing: Perfect. Tag me in the thread when the first s3 upload completes. :rocket:
